dedupe_keys.name: desyco decision support system for coastal climate change impact assessment cmcc

description: DESYCO is a GIS-based decision support system for the integrated assessment of multiple climate change impacts on coastal systems such as beaches, wetlands, forests, protected areas, groundwater, and urban and agricultural areas. It implements a Regional Risk Assessment method based on multi-criteria decision analysis to identify exposed areas, estimate susceptibility, calculate relative risk and evaluate potential damage, and so to rank areas and targets at risk. Inputs include climate projections, hydrodynamic and hydrological model results for sea level rise, storm surge, waves, temperature and salinity, and coastal topography, geomorphology, vegetation and infrastructure locations; outputs are exposure, susceptibility, risk and damage maps. It was developed by the CMCC risk assessment and adaptation strategies division as open-source software handling raster and shapefile data with a graphical interface, and applied in the North Adriatic, the Gulf of Gabès in Tunisia, the Veneto and Friuli plain and the Esino river basin. Caveats: no download link or licence is given on the page read, results are relative risk scores, and the tool is tied to regional applications. It supports regional coastal hazard exposure and risk ranking for adaptation planning; a related record is the DIVA coastal model.
